headline: Pakistan Reduces Retail Fuel Prices for Petrol and Diesel
summary: Pakistan's Ministry of Energy reduced domestic ex-depot prices for high-speed diesel by 4 rupees per liter and petrol by 1 rupee per liter, reflecting official OGRA notifications.
why: OGRA (Oil & Gas Regulatory Authority) regulates fuel pricing mechanisms in Pakistan.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Pakistan lowered domestic retail prices for petrol and diesel.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
